text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Scored winter 2025-26, weekday nights 22:00 to 08:00 with a daily mean temperature below 8 C. Dashed black line: observed power. Coloured lines: median day-ahead forecast after the filter. Past weather. The page's table gives the step in points and MW.'
